caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a metal oil lamp, shown in a three-quarter view. The lamp is rendered in black and gray tones with shading to create a sense of three dimensions. It features a stout, rounded base with a slightly raised, domed lid at the center. Attached to the right side of the lamp is a tall, narrow, vertical handle that arches upward and then straightens, ending in a pointed tip that curves outward with a small prong or hook. The body of the lamp is oval and squat, and there is a spout on the left front side. The background of the drawing is a solid light beige color with no additional objects, patterns, or markings, creating a stark contrast to the central object. The composition centers the lamp on the page, with ample negative space surrounding it.
title: Betty Lamp
